status: Fixed before any grouped-split model is trained. Separate new experiment; locked results and manuscript claims are not replaced.
prepared_with: Assistant assistance (Claude); author approved running the experiment on 2026-09-23
question: Do the main C2 degradation and C3 recovery hold when exact-duplicate feature vectors can never appear in both the training and test partitions?
motivating_evidence: 30.6% of prepared rows are in exact-duplicate groups (DoS 53.6%, Bot 48.9%); 28.5% of random-split test rows have an exact training copy; 1,156 groups (3,140 rows) hold identical Benign and Infiltration vectors.
dataset: Exact verified 119571 x 70 prepared matrix (X sha256 b852fe0225df0c7b3a3407c3d2c98bccfa2a6252b144f3e2e6d6ba5549df5e6e); no rows removed
groups: One group per exact 70-feature vector (byte-identical float32 row). 89,064 groups.
label_conflict_policy: Keep every row and its original label. Groups holding more than one label are kept whole and form their own 'conflict' stratum. No row is dropped or relabelled.

split.method: Stratified group split: groups are assigned to a stratum (their single class, or 'conflict'); within each stratum groups are visited in a seeded random order and added to the test set while the stratum's test rows stay at or below round(0.30 x stratum rows); overshooting groups are skipped. Train and test positions are then shuffled with the same seeded generator.
gates: No group appears in both partitions
Train and test are disjoint and cover all 119,571 rows

transformation: Unchanged historical hybrid768 operator from the locked code; transformed-matrix hash must equal the verified audit record.
selection: Unchanged main pipeline on training rows only: 55 candidates, KS two-sample with Holm (alpha 0.05) comparing original and transformed training rows, MI on original training values (20,000-row subsample, seed = split seed), keep MI >= 0.05 in stable-candidate order.
models: Locked constructors (RF 200 trees; XGBoost 300 estimators, depth 6, lr 0.3; MLP (64,32), early stopping), model seed 42. MLP scaler fit on training columns only. C1 and C2 share one fitted 70-feature model; C3 is one fit on the selected columns. RF predictions use n_jobs=1, as in the operator-sensitivity run.

conditions.C3: Selected-feature model, transformed test rows restricted to the selected columns

statistics.descriptive: Split-level means, paired C2-C1 and C3-C1 differences, min/max, and the difference from the locked random-split means.
statistics.registered_procedure_reused: The same weighted-F1 families as the main design, unchanged: paired test on C2-C1 and on C3-C1 (Shapiro-Wilk >= 0.05 -> paired t-test, else Wilcoxon), Holm across the three models; paired TOST on C3-C1 at +/-0.01 (primary) and +/-0.005 (sensitivity), Holm across the three models.
statistics.caveat: Splits share rows, so the tests carry the same overlapping-split dependence as the main analysis. Per-class results are descriptive only (author decision on per-attack equivalence).

decision_rule: The main claim is supported under grouped splits for a model if C2 is below C1 (Holm-adjusted p < 0.05) and C3-C1 meets TOST at +/-0.01 after Holm. A model that fails either is reported as a boundary. The +/-0.005 result is reported as sensitivity. The rule is fixed before results exist.
output: Split positions and hashes, group-integrity checks, feature selections with KS D and MI, fit records, 90 prediction/probability files, metrics, statistics, environment, warnings and logs.
limitations: Exact duplicates only; near-duplicates are not grouped
Main representation and historical hybrid768 operator only
Not a temporal or capture-day holdout
